findings: components[2].sound and learner.components[2]: E7 supplies a reported Old Chinese comparison for 還 (*ɡʷraːn) and 睘 (*ɡʷeŋ). Add this comparison to the component’s sound data with its stated system and cite E7; retain a separate limitation that this reported comparison does not independently establish 睘’s identity, reading, or phonetic fit. The learner card should briefly explain the proposed sound relationship, without duplicating the displayed readings.
